newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S COMBINED WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S COMBINED WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of the women's combined gold medal at the Alpine skiing world championships on Saturday:
World Cup wins: 4 - Slalom: Lillehammer (93); Super-G: Flachau (95); Downhill: Vail (96); Combined: St. Anton (94)

Other facts: The combined title marks Goetschl's first-ever medal. She made her first appearance at a big event at last year's world championships in Sierra Nevada where she placed fourth in combined. Has been a regular on the World Cup circuit for four years. She surprised by clinching her maiden victory in Lillehammer in 1993 in one of her first appearances on the World Cup.
